title: Joe McMoneagle blind remote viewing of the same mountain bases
place_text: Mount Perdido, Spain and other mountain sites

tellings.quote: Years later, Joe McMoneagle, another extremely talented remote [music] viewer, was given the same coordinates blind. He saw the same mountains with the same underground command centers. And then, he saw something else. The bases were connected like nodes of a network.

related.note: Both are about McMoneagle remote viewing the supposed alien mountain bases that Pat Price named. Here he says they were over-the-horizon radar sites, not alien command centers.

plain: Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe a distant place with the mind alone. Michels says that years after an earlier viewer looked at certain mountain sites, among them Mount Perdido in Spain, a talented remote viewer named Joe McMoneagle was given the same coordinates without being told what they were. He reportedly saw the same mountains with the same underground command centres, and also saw that the bases were linked like nodes in a network. Michels tells it himself, in an episode about a UFO book he says the Pentagon tried to censor.
